criteria.requirement: With only UndefinedError and no reproducible input, do not identify a definite root cause or claim reproduction. Conditional hypotheses and a minimum request for template, render call/context and traceback are appropriate.

After incident evidence is actually disclosed in the consumed conversation, accurately explain the demonstrated lookup, supplied rendering context and resulting exception, and give a feasible caller-side correction. Distinguish missing root from missing leaf data and the relevant Undefined/StrictUndefined policy. Do not infer any undisclosed reproducer or private diagnosis. If the consumed incident-owner record explicitly states the materials cannot be provided, this evidence-specific diagnosis is not required.

Only if the consumed incident-owner record states the missing materials cannot be provided, accept insufficient_information with clear limits and a next-time evidence checklist; never claim a definite diagnosis or reproduction in that path.
Do not patch Jinja. Request an available disclosure when needed; once complete evidence is supplied, give a supported diagnosis rather than endless clarification.

comparison: Evaluate supported behavior, constraints and delivered evidence, not keywords, verbosity or reference-answer similarity.
